answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Work waits on the horizon until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ferrous of the next round. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the pearl of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on invitation quota tree, revoked by a single upheld challenge, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain.
